name: ModelVariant663_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant663_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (strip columns that spawn at a tracked model point and fan out as sixteen Gouraud strips, plus up to four bursts of 32 rays with Gouraud triangles and a spinning sixteen-strip fan, released on a per-command timetable); for a non-negative request it sets the effect up from the command row indexed by the request, otherwise it runs one frame; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)

HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
